Each challenge carries a 47 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 73 aliases means authoring 73 texts that each match their own nonce. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
